query:
SELECT conservation_status, COUNT(*) as count
FROM plants
WHERE conservation_status IS NOT NULL AND conservation_status != 'NE'
GROUP BY conservation_status
ORDER BY CASE conservation_status 
  WHEN 'EX' THEN 1 WHEN 'EW' THEN 2 WHEN 'CR' THEN 3 
  WHEN 'EN' THEN 4 WHEN 'VU' THEN 5 WHEN 'NT' THEN 6 
  WHEN 'LC' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END;
